text: Proposal: update the Matrix transpiler heading to match the config file named in its steps. The historical update changes the instructions to babel.config.js but leaves the heading Custom .babelrc. A reviewer requested a matching heading; final source did not apply it. The fixed accepted instructions now name babel.config.cjs, while the heading still says .babelrc. Match that current filename when revising this documentation. The sourceMaps:false setting is intentionally in the config; no build/transpile command or upstream tool version was executed or verified by this study.
title: Use the same Matrix Babel config name in steps and heading
